drafts.title: $1.45 to roast the turkey on electric
drafts.angle: The grocery bill went up 6%. The power to cook it is almost nothing, and on solar it's less. Timely today, light human moment.
bullets: AFBF 2026: classic Thanksgiving dinner for 10 is $58.63, up about 6% from 2025, first increase since 2022. West region $58.74.
Plug & Penny (Nov 20): a 14 to 18 lb turkey in an electric oven costs about $1.36 to $1.54 at the US average 18.16 cents/kWh (about 2 kWh an hour for 3.75 to 4.25 hours).
Hawaii's rate pushes the same bird to $3.54 to $4.01; Nevada's to under $1.10.
